top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director could not produce 30 hours of required annual training.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.
